description: A Rails-inspired Active Record for Cloudflare Workers and D1: models with validations, callbacks, associations, and change tracking; lazy, composable queries; and a predictable save lifecycle.
rules: Never pass a request's whole body, form or query string to a Model: name the fields, with destructuring or Model.permit(body, ...names).
Name attributes in camelCase everywhere (where, order, pluck, foreignKey); snake_case column names appear only inside sql fragments.
Write custom SQL as an sql tagged template, which binds every value.
save() and update() resolve to false when validation fails, with the reasons in record.errors; check what writes return.
